description: The countryside cycle follows Pat and Mat through years of cottage life, from beds, plumbing and paper tableware to a projector, vacuum cleaner, pool, flooring, garden problems, juice making, exercise equipment, tiling and shade.

s11e01.description: Pat and Mat need a second bed in a cramped bedroom, so they explore increasingly unconventional sleeping arrangements until the room itself becomes part of the furniture design.

s11e02.description: The countryside house needs a dependable water supply, prompting Pat and Mat to run pipes and improvise plumbing until getting water from one place to another becomes a project in its own right.

s11e03.description: Disposable paper plates seem too useful to throw away, so Pat and Mat try to wash and reuse them, then have to decide what to do with the paper pulp produced by that excellent idea.

s11e04.description: Pat and Mat set up a projector for a home screening, only to discover that showing a film requires more than pointing the machine at a wall, leading to improvised solutions for the entire cinema setup.

s11e05.description: Housecleaning with a vacuum cleaner becomes a mechanical project when the appliance proves inadequate, and Pat and Mat begin adapting both the machine and the way the dirt reaches it.

s11e06.description: On a hot day Pat and Mat decide to cool off with a swimming pool, turning a simple backyard setup into another sequence of construction, filling and water-management problems.

s11e07.description: A troublesome floor needs attention, so Pat and Mat tackle the surface themselves, using tools and improvised methods that make laying or repairing the floor more ambitious than the room requires.

s11e08.description: A dead tree in the yard becomes the next problem to solve, and Pat and Mat bring their usual combination of tools, leverage and homemade machinery to a job that should have been straightforward.

s11e09.description: Pat and Mat decide to make fresh orange juice, but squeezing fruit by hand is clearly beneath men with access to tools, so the kitchen gradually acquires a purpose-built juicing system.

s11e10.description: An exercise bike promises convenient fitness at home, and Pat and Mat immediately begin adjusting, improving and repurposing the machine until the workout depends as much on engineering as pedaling.

s11e11.description: A cactus presents Pat and Mat with the practical problem of handling and caring for something covered in spikes, inspiring protective gear and increasingly indirect ways of getting close to the plant.

s11e12.description: Pat and Mat take on bathroom tiling, where straight lines, adhesive and awkward surfaces turn a decorative job into a test of measuring and improvised installation.

s11e13.description: Strong sun convinces Pat and Mat that they need better shade, so they design a sunshade whose supports, coverage and operation become more complicated with every attempted improvement.
